title: The Lantern Carried So Hands Stay Free
youtube_title: The Lantern Carried So Hands Stay Free | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness leaves a person with their dignity intact.
summary: At a school hallway of pegs, stools, and music stands, a lantern carried so someone else could hold a pie is awkward for one person. Kira notices Neighbor Sami struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
